title: Ensuring Campus Transport and Food Court Services in Local Universities are Sufficient for Students
what_it_is: Ensuring Campus Transport and Food Court Services in Local Universities are Sufficient for Students

sections.label: Campus transport and food court guidelines
sections.summary: Asked whether MOE will consider guidelines for universities on campus transport and food court services, including peak-hour priority and tour group registration; AUs will monitor and adjust measures.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Education whether the Ministry will consider implementing guidelines for local universities to ensure that campus transport and food court services are sufficient for students’ needs and well-being, in view of the recent overcrowding issues.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: These include prioritising campus transport and food court access for students and staff during peak hours and requiring advance registration before allowing tour groups on campus.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: AUs will continue to monitor the situation and adjust their measures accordingly.

sections.label: MOE and university visitor management
sections.summary: MOE meets AUs regularly and will intervene as necessary; AUs set their own visitor policies, with NUS and NTU measures and STB coordination on tour operators.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
sentences.text: With regard to his first question, MOE meets regularly with the AUs at various platforms, including at the Ministerial level.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
sentences.text: AUs are given the space and autonomy to manage the day-to-day logistics and welfare of the students.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
sentences.text: But in this case, MOE will intervene as necessary.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
sentences.text: With regard to the Member's second question, the AUs do have different campus contexts and also very different visitor profiles and are thus best placed to determine the right visitor management policies on their own needs, on their own ground.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
sentences.text: For example, responding to an increase in tourists, NUS has introduced enhanced measures in August and more recently, in September and October as well, during key periods.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
sentences.text: For NTU, they have enforced designated paths and schedules for tourists in order to prioritise the needs and well-being of students and staff.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
sentences.text: With regard to tour operators, currently the AUs are working closely with the Singapore Tourism Board (STB) to communicate any new policy and measures that are being implemented in schools.
